build.note: Ice time × production per 60 minutes, both recency-weighted and blended with a position average, then scaled by how many goals the opponent allows compared with the league. Then adjusted for how he has done against our own forecasts: 455 points against 417.6 forecast in his earlier games, shrunk toward no adjustment. The model then turns this average into the chance of each count.

player_context.note: Newer appearances carry more weight. Ice time has a 14-appearance half-life; production per minute has a 110-appearance half-life. The offseason does not age player history. A player who has consistently beaten (or missed) our earlier forecasts gets a shrunk adjustment toward that record. Observed averages below are unweighted. Participation and current role remain unconfirmed.
